guides.title: Getting paid on public contracts: payment terms and late payment
guides.description: What the 30-day payment term in public contracts means, what makes an invoice valid, and the steps to take when a public buyer or main contractor pays late.
guides.hook:
You finish the job, send the invoice, and then wait. On public contracts the law now sets a 30-day payment term, but it only helps if you know what counts as a valid invoice and what to do when the money does not arrive.

Most small firms never look at the payment clause until a payment is late, and by then the options are narrower.

Our new guide covers the 30-day rule, valid invoices, paying your own subcontractors, statutory interest and fixed recovery sums, and where to complain.
